scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with a specifically treated exceptional coefficient-range case; a standard-library exhaustive finite checker supports, but does not certify, the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Applies to uniform integral weight w>=2 and naturally oriented cycles, intrinsic lattice width only; no assertion for arbitrary orientations, nonuniform weights or Euclidean width. Historical priority is provisional and independent audit has not occurred.
title: Parity-sharp lattice width and Lucas-number minimum directions of weighted directed-cycle simplices
